restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network is stealing credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Observable evidence such as LSASS process memory access, credential dumping tool execution (e.g., Mimikatz), suspicious access to SAM/SECURITY registry hives, or anomalous authentication events indicating credential theft.
what_would_refute: Absence of any credential access activity on compromised Windows hosts, including no LSASS access, no credential dumping tool artifacts, and no suspicious registry hive access.
